title: The Existence of a Neutron
author: James Chadwick
description: Experimental discovery of the neutron completing the picture of atomic structure
rights: NOT cleared by renewal, and renewal was never the question. Proceedings of the Royal Society, London, 1932 — a UK publication, and US renewal requirements never applied to it. Foreign works that failed US formalities were restored by the URAA in 1996 and run 95 years from publication, so this enters the US public domain on 1 January 2028. Nothing to do but wait.
